parsed.critic: C06 pairs 520 kg/m3 cement with zero SCM and only 5.2 superplasticizer at w/c 0.33, risking workability/bleeding that could cut measured strength below prediction.
parsed.selection_rationale: These five lead on predicted strength while spanning low-water ternary (C01/C04), binary slag (C02), high-cement high-SP (C03) and plain high-cement (C06) designs, so testing them discriminates binder type from water content and checks the SCM upside against model uncertainty (SD 7.8-9.5 MPa).

arguments.analyst: Observed strengths rise with cement plus slag/fly-ash binder and low water, as in mix-226 and mix-370, while the weakest mixes share very low cement with high water (mix-081, mix-096).
arguments.hypothesis: Candidates combining total binder above ~450 kg/m3 with water below ~170 kg/m3 will measure above 55 MPa at 28 days, whereas high-water low-cement mixes will fall below 25 MPa.

decision.analyst: Observed strengths rise with cement plus slag/fly-ash binder and low water, as in mix-226 and mix-370, while the weakest mixes share very low cement with high water (mix-081, mix-096).
decision.hypothesis: Candidates combining total binder above ~450 kg/m3 with water below ~170 kg/m3 will measure above 55 MPa at 28 days, whereas high-water low-cement mixes will fall below 25 MPa.
decision.critic: C06 pairs 520 kg/m3 cement with zero SCM and only 5.2 superplasticizer at w/c 0.33, risking workability/bleeding that could cut measured strength below prediction.
decision.selection_rationale: These five lead on predicted strength while spanning low-water ternary (C01/C04), binary slag (C02), high-cement high-SP (C03) and plain high-cement (C06) designs, so testing them discriminates binder type from water content and checks the SCM upside against model uncertainty (SD 7.8-9.5 MPa).
